title: Shot coverage gap checker — interval_check.py
purpose: Reusable standard-library Python utility that validates a list of (start, end) shot intervals against a total duration. Detects gaps, overlaps and reversed/out-of-range intervals. Intended for pre-render shot plan validation; no video model is involved.
